observations.behavior: Archiving a skill no longer unconditionally calls category-count refresh; it now checks if the skillTabsLogic is mounted before invoking the action.
observations.posthog_connection: This guards the category-count refresh against the case where the tab bar is not mounted, preventing a potential runtime error or unnecessary API call when the skill is archived while the tab bar is not visible.

observations.behavior: The afterMount lifecycle no longer unconditionally calls category-count refresh; the call is removed, relying on the explicit archive-path invocation.
observations.posthog_connection: This removes a redundant or potentially unsafe category-count refresh on mount, relying instead on the archive-path invocation and the explicit mount of skillTabsLogic.

observations.behavior: Adds a new skillTabsLogic module that computes and exposes category-backed tab configuration and a loader for category counts.
observations.posthog_connection: This establishes the shared tab-bar configuration and the loader that fetches category counts, which P1.F4.H10 and P1.F4.H11 depend on. It also defines the SKILL_CATEGORY_TABS configuration and the URL helpers.
